sentences.content: Bill is my new friend. He’s short and heavy.
sentences.english: Bill is my new friend . He's short and heavy
sentences.chinese: Bill是我的新朋友。他又矮又胖。

sentences.content: He goes fishing. She does the cleaning. They have some juice.
sentences.english: He goes fishing . She does the cleaning . They have some juice
sentences.chinese: 他去钓鱼。她负责打扫。他们喝了些果汁。

sentences.content: Bill is playing ping-pong. Some people are swimming.
sentences.english: Bill is playing ping-pong . Some people are swimming
sentences.chinese: Bill正在打乒乓球。一些人在游泳。

sentences.content: Saturday was a busy day for me. In the morning, I got up early.
sentences.english: Saturday was a busy day for me . In the morning , I got up early
sentences.chinese: 周六对我来说是忙碌的一天。早上，我早早地起床了。

sentences.content: Guess! Is this bigger or smaller than the elephant?
sentences.english: Guess ! Is this bigger or smaller than the elephant ?
sentences.chinese: 猜猜看！这个比大象大还是小？

sentences.content: The whale is the biggest, and the tiger is the smallest.
sentences.english: The whale is the biggest , and the tiger is the smallest
sentences.chinese: 鲸鱼是最大的，老虎是最小的。

sentences.content: We are going to have a farewell party. You can bring your friends.
sentences.english: We are going to have a farewell party . You can bring your friends
sentences.chinese: 我们将举办一场欢送会，你可以带上你的朋友。

sentences.content: We will draw pictures, sing songs and give prizes for the best pictures.
sentences.english: We will draw pictures , sing songs and give prizes for the best pictures
sentences.chinese: 我们将画画、唱歌，并为最佳画作颁发奖品。

sentences.content: Don’t be late for the party. We’ll have a happy day.
sentences.english: Don't be late for the party . We'll have a happy day
sentences.chinese: 别迟到派对。我们会度过愉快的一天。

wordDetails.definition: we（将来时缩写）: 我们将

sentences.content: Good luck! Keep in touch. Take care.
sentences.english: Good luck ! Keep in touch . Take care
sentences.chinese: 祝你好运！保持联系。保重。
